a range of things that can be chosen 可供选择的一系列事物 The plan has a wide choice of options. [=there are many options that can be chosen] 该方案有多种选择。 You have the choice of coffee or tea. 你可以选择咖啡或茶。 The menu does not have much choice. [=selection] 菜单没有太多选择。 (chiefly Brit) Customers are spoiled for choice [=customers have a lot of choices] when buying a new car. （主要用于英式英语）顾客在购买新车时可谓选择丰富。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

[=option] 她想要比萨，但那不是一个选择。 There is a wide range of choices. 有很多选择。 Other choices on the menu looked equally tempting. 菜单上的其他选择看起来同样诱人。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 31ab1ad7-f146-4276-ba91-89aab0e75875 182c12eb-a83b-4495-b2b1-61f6be9e6196 choice noun ˈtʃoɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/choice01.wav count the person or thing that someone chooses 某人选择的人或事物 He is happy with his choice. 他对自己的选择感到满意。 She is my first choice for the job. [=she is the one I most want for the job] 她是我这份工作的首选。 I don't like her choice of friends. 我不喜欢她选择的朋友。 Selling our car was the right choice. 卖掉我们的车是正确的选择。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 992f0816-0a1f-47a0-a203-361e92294bd4 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav + obj to put (something or someone) in a particular place or position 把（某物或某人）放在特定的地方或位置 Please place [=set, lay] the book on my desk. 请把那本书放在我的书桌上。 She placed [=rested] her hand on his shoulder. 她把手放在他的肩膀上。 The box was placed at the center of the room. 盒子被放在房间的中央。 You can really see the similarities when you place the two pictures side by side.
Her name was placed on the list.
The husbands and wives were placed in separate groups.
New flowers had been placed [=positioned] around the edges of the garden.
They were placed next to each other in line. 当你把这两张照片并排放置时，你真的能看到它们的相似之处。
她的名字被列在名单上。
丈夫和妻子被分在不同的小组。
新花被摆放在花园的边缘周围。
他们在队伍中被安排在彼此旁边。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k d645f749-0212-451d-bc45-cebff71c4bc7 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav + obj to put (someone or something) in a particular state, condition, or situation 使（某人或某物）处于特定的状态、条件或情境中 Working with sick people places him at risk for infection. 与病人一起工作使他有感染的风险。 By not accepting the prosecutor's deal, he places his future in the hands of the jury. 由于没有接受检察官的协议，他把自己的未来交到了陪审团手中。 We're placing you under arrest. 我们要逮捕你。 He was released from jail and placed on probation. 他被释放出狱，并被处以缓刑。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 347964d0-a022-4a43-8815-f8360b14af61 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav [+ on or upon]
used to say that something is thought of as important, valuable, etc. 用于表示某事被认为是重要的、有价值的等。 They place great importance on both work and family. [=they believe that both work and family are important] 他们非常重视工作和家庭。 She talked about the high value that her parents place on education. 她谈到了她父母对教育的高度重视。 Some parents place a lot of emphasis on winning, but we just want our children to have fun playing sports. 有些家长非常重视获胜，但我们只是希望孩子们在运动中玩得开心。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k e08ce7b6-1f15-4348-87f1-93c655884e05 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav used to say who or what you believe should be trusted, blamed, etc. 用来表示你认为谁或什么应该被信任、被责备等。 We have no choice but to place our faith in the legal system. [=to trust the legal system] 我们别无选择，只能把信任寄托在法律体系上。 Too many children in this country are overweight, and I place most of the blame on a lack of exercise. [=I blame the problem on a lack of exercise] 在这个国家，太多的孩子超重了，我认为主要原因是缺乏锻炼。 Their plan places heavy reliance [=their plan relies heavily] upon cooperation from others. 他们的计划在很大程度上依赖于他人的合作。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k b60c9b4d-2e21-43e1-9eb6-0afc3fbfa2ef d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav + obj [+ on or upon]
to cause or require someone or something to deal with (a demand, burden, etc.) 使某人或某事必须应对（要求、负担等）；强加于…… The growing population is placing increasing demands on our schools. [=it is causing our schools to deal with increasing demands] 不断增长的人口正在对我们的学校提出越来越多的要求。 The financial burden of the program is ultimately placed upon the taxpayers. [=the taxpayers have to pay for the program] 该项目的财政负担最终由纳税人承担。 He managed to get a lot done, considering the time constraints that were placed on him. 考虑到他所面临的时间限制，他还是设法完成了很多事情。 restrictions placed upon a person's freedom 对个人自由施加的限制 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 48698e3e-8d48-415e-8bbb-3d2722ced3e8 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav to perform the actions that are required for (something) 执行（某事）所需的操作 He placed a collect (phone) call to his wife. 他给妻子打了一个对方付费电话。 Place your bets. 请下注。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 41c61542-68fe-497a-b593-e86e5b93326f d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav to give (an order) to someone 给某人下达（命令） The company placed an order (with the manufacturer) for an additional 100 units. 公司向制造商追加订购了100台。 “Are you ready to place your order?” asked the waiter. “您准备好点餐了吗？”服务员问道。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k cf09e878-667c-45d1-9ed7-4187a1f627b8 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav to cause (something, such as an advertisement) to appear somewhere 使（某物，例如广告）出现在某处 We tried selling our house by placing an ad in the newspaper. 我们试着在报纸上刊登广告来卖我们的房子。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 0da259c1-aa94-4fb3-a2e6-841ffa24178e d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav + obj to find an appropriate place for (someone) to live, work, or learn 为（某人）找到一个合适的居住、工作或学习的地方 The agency helps place unemployed workers. 该机构帮助安置失业工人。 The child was removed from the home and placed in the care of relatives. 孩子被带离了家中，安置在亲属的照料下。 The children were placed with a foster family. 这些孩子被安置在一个寄养家庭。 In high school, she was placed in advanced math and science classes. 在高中时，她被分到高级数学和科学课程。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 259f56c2-41cd-4d43-818a-369e940f2afa d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav + obj to show or prove the location of (someone or something) at a particular time 在特定时间显示或证明（某人或某物）的位置 The evidence places you at the scene of the crime. 证据显示你出现在犯罪现场。 Investigators were able to place him at several of these meetings. 调查人员能够证明他出现在其中几次会议上。 The company's records place three of their trucks in the area that day. 该公司的记录显示，当天有三辆卡车在该地区。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 62b0e0a5-cbc0-4708-bac4-d28c5653cb42 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav + obj to remember where you saw (someone or someone's face) in the past 记得你以前在哪里见过（某人或某人的脸） The man looked familiar but she couldn't quite place him. 这个男人看起来很面熟，但她一时想不起他是谁。 It wasn't until later that I placed her face: she was my ninth grade English teacher, Ms. Lee. 直到后来我才认出她的脸：她是我九年级的英语老师，李老师。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 7d59f449-4ee4-423f-b3eb-ba110f58d715 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav no obj, US to end a race or competition in a particular position 以特定名次结束比赛或竞赛 He placed fifth in last year's race. 他在去年的比赛中获得了第五名。 The team placed second overall. 该队总体上获得了第二名。 The first three participants to place in each event will receive medals. 每个项目中前三名的参赛者将获得奖牌。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 23aaebf2-5599-4ea2-825d-d44ec6e4d017 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav British [Someone who is placed first, second, etc., in a race or competition has finished in that position.] （在比赛或竞赛中获得第一、第二等名次的人，是以该名次完成比赛的。） He was placed fifth in last year's race. 他在去年的比赛中获得了第五名。 The team was placed second overall. 该队最终获得了第二名。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 8d6779b8-20a3-400c-a202-821a49e2b715 d552c9e4-ff51-41f9-a8bc-c43bf2be2eff place verb ˈpleɪs https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/place001.wav + obj to give (someone or something) a particular rank in a series or category 给（某人或某物）在一个系列或类别中赋予特定的等级 Tolstoy's War and Peace is often placed [=ranked, rated] among the greatest masterpieces of world literature. 托尔斯泰的《战争与和平》常被列为世界文学中最伟大的杰作之一。 Among the most serious problems facing the world, global warming is often placed first. 在世界面临的最严重问题中，全球变暖通常被排在首位。 The administration places [=puts, sets] improving the country's health-care system high on their list of priorities. 政府将改善国家医疗保健系统列为他们的优先事项之一。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

not having or including another only one 没有或不包括其他，只有一个 They lost by a single point. [=they lost by one point] 他们只输了一分。 A single shoe was found. 发现了一只鞋。 It costs $10 for a single glass of wine! 一杯葡萄酒竟然要10美元！ a single serving of carrots

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 039eed8e-4d7f-4385-b5e1-45883ecb58ff 48be22a1-14df-4c89-914e-f6d99a0e5e97 rule noun ˈruːl https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/r/rule0001.wav a statement that tells you what is or is not allowed in a particular game, situation, etc. 一条说明在特定游戏、情境等中允许或不允许什么的规定。 I understand the basic rules of chess. 我了解国际象棋的基本规则。 As long as you're living under our roof, you'll follow/obey our rules. 只要你还住在我们家里，你就得遵守我们的规矩。 The college has strict rules for qualifying for financial assistance. 该学院对获得经济资助有严格的规定。 The new rule allows/permits employees to dress casually on Fridays.
Under the new rules, casual dress is now allowed.
the company's rules and regulations
It's important to learn the rules of the road before taking your driving test.
